validation: CPU-only httptest with the SDK's actual SSE/JSON decoder
client_construction: explicit ChatCompletionService and ModelService; no environment defaults
terminal_contract: choice zero finish (stop or length), exact framed [DONE], no premature EOF
usage_required: final choices-empty usage chunk after finish; nonnegative integer prompt_tokens and completion_tokens; validate total_tokens if present
cached_tokens: optional; missing/null is unknown, present zero is known
usage_off: no stream_options, server counts and durations remain unknown
timing: first nonempty visible content TTFT; wall through terminal stream completion
generation_defaults: send explicit temperature/seed, including zero; omission requires configuration
cache_modes: miss only, unverified unless response cached usage is present
live_vllm_validation: not performed; continuation and prefix-reset gates deferred
fixtures: sanitized synthetic streams embedded in package tests; not GPU captures
dependency_note: SDK module graph includes Azure/AWS/auth/WebSocket packages; not dependency-free
